transactions.desc: The Athletics claimed Rom off waivers Tuesday.
The Marlins recalled Pauley from Triple-A Jacksonville on Tuesday, Kevin Barral of FishonFirst.com reports.
Woodford agreed to a minor-league contract with the Rays on Monday, Marc Topkin of the Tampa Bay Times reports.
The Blue Jays released Alcala on Tuesday.
The Giants selected Morgan's contract from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of Monday's game against the Astros, Alex Pavlovic of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
The Dodgers designated Hernandez for assignment Monday.
The Dodgers optioned Hurt to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Monday.
The Dodgers selected Barnes' contract from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Monday.
The Rockies recalled Norby from Triple-A Albuquerque on Monday.
The Angels selected Peralta's contract from Triple-A Salt Lake on Monday.
The Rangers recalled Peoples from Triple-A Round Rock on Monday.
The Athletics designated Ornelas for assignment Monday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Strowd to Triple-A Reno on Monday.
The Athletics activated Gelof (knee) from the 10-day injured list Monday.
The Diamondbacks reinstated Soroka (glute) from the 15-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start against the Rockies on Monday.
The Dodgers recalled Halvorsen from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Monday, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.
The Mariners claimed Kingham off waivers from the Rangers on Monday.
The Royals optioned McGee to Triple-A Omaha on Monday.
The Orioles recalled Sanders from Triple-A Norfolk on Monday.
The Orioles optioned Povich to Triple-A Norfolk on Monday.
The Astros claimed Velazquez off waivers from the Cardinals on Monday, Brian McTaggart of MLB.com reports.
The Mets recalled Pintaro from Triple-A Syracuse on Monday.
The Phillies recalled Shugart from Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Monday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Marlins claimed Gonzalez off waivers from the White Sox on Monday and optioned him to Triple-A Jacksonville.
The Blue Jays designated MacIver for assignment Monday.
The Blue Jays optioned Schneider to Triple-A Buffalo on Monday, Ben Nicholson-Smith of Sportsnet.ca reports.
The Blue Jays optioned Estrada to Triple-A Buffalo on Monday, Ben Nicholson-Smith of Sportsnet.ca reports.
The Blue Jays recalled McAdoo from Triple-A Buffalo on Monday. He'll start at third base and bat seventh in the Blue Jays' series opener versus the Red Sox.
The Blue Jays selected Woods Richardson's contract from Triple-A Buffalo on Monday, Ben Nicholson-Smith of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Triple-A St. Paul reinstated Rodriguez (thumb) from the 60-day injured list Monday, Theodore Tollefson of ZoneCoverage.com reports.
